translation.title: Salicylic Acid Acne Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the treatment of acne.
translation.usage: Apply it twice a day, in the morning and in the evening. Because excessive skin dryness can occur, start with once a day, and if your skin becomes dry or starts peeling, you can reduce the applications to once every two days.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or have had a hypersensitivity reaction to it, or if you have diabetes or a blood circulation disorder. Do not apply it around the eyes, on mucous membranes, or on areas with infection, inflammation, redness or irritation. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have experienced allergic reactions to medicines or cosmetics (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer), if you have a liver or kidney disorder, if you are hypersensitive to propylene glycol or have had an allergic reaction to it, if you have festering (purulent) dermatitis, weeping (oozing) skin or erosion (raw skin), if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or for children and adolescents who have chickenpox or influenza. Be careful when applying it to a widespread affected area, as side effects occur more easily. This medicine is for external use only. Follow the directed dose and schedule exactly. If you are breastfeeding, do not apply it to the breast area. For children, use it under the supervision of a guardian. Take care that it does not touch skin other than the affected area. Take care that it does not touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it gets into the eyes, rinse completely with plenty of water. If this medicine is accidentally swallowed, consult a doctor or pharmacist. If your symptoms do not improve after repeated use, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Adverse reactions such as rash, redness, erythema (red patches), itching, or a local irritation reaction where the medicine touches healthy skin may occur; if they do, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, keep out of reach of children, keep away from fire, and close the cap tightly when not in use.
